title: Senior Engineer - Cloud & Infra Services
description:
**Role description**

Job Title: Senior Engineer - Cloud & Infra Services  
Location: Coimbatore  
Experience: 3-5 years

We are urgently seeking a highly skilled Senior Engineer to join our Cloud & Infra Services team. This critical role demands immediate expertise in Azure Active Directory, M365, and Windows Server environments to drive essential infrastructure projects and support.

Job Description:  
1. Administer and support critical Microsoft 365 services, ensuring high availability and optimal performance.  
2. Manage and troubleshoot Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID) for user provisioning, synchronization, and identity management.  
3. Provide expert support for Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, DNS, and authentication services.  
4. Develop and maintain robust PowerShell scripts for automation, reporting, and operational efficiency across cloud and on-premise infrastructure.  
5. Configure and troubleshoot essential security solutions, including MFA, DKIM, DMARC, and SPF, to protect our cloud services.  
6. Collaborate effectively with infrastructure, security, and project teams to deliver seamless cloud and infrastructure integration and migration initiatives.  
7. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.  
8. Participate actively in troubleshooting, issue resolution, and post-implementation support for cloud and infrastructure services.

Skills and Qualifications:  
Proven experience (3-5 years) in cloud and infrastructure engineering roles.  
Mandatory expertise in Azure Active Directory and M365 Suites of Products.  
Strong proficiency with Windows Server administration and troubleshooting.  
Demonstrated ability to develop and utilize PowerShell for automation.  
Solid understanding of networking, security, and identity management principles.  
Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to system health.

Why Join Us:  
This is an urgent opportunity to make an immediate impact within a fast-paced and dynamic environment. You will contribute directly to the stability and evolution of our critical cloud and infrastructure services.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Apply now to join our innovative team.

  
**Skills**

**Mandatory Skills :** Azure Active Directory, M365 Suites of Products, Windows Server

 **About LTM**  
LTM is an AI-centric global technology services company and the Business Creativity partner to the world’s largest and most disruptive enterprises. We bring human insights and intelligent systems together to help clients create greater value at the intersection of technology and domain expertise. Our capabilities span integrated operations, transformation, and business AI — enabling new ways of working, new productivity paradigms, and new roads to value. Together with over 87,000 employees across 40 countries and our global network of partners, LTM — a Larsen & Toubro company — owns business outcomes for our clients, helping them not just outperform the market, but to Outcreate it. title: AI video Creator / Generative AI Video Specialist
description:
**Job Description: AI Video Creator (5+ Years Experience)**

**Job Title:** AI video creator /Generative AI Video Specialist  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 5+ Years  
**Salary:** Up to ₹80,000  
**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**contact person :**

**kaviya R.**

**6380750897**

**Job summary:**

**Job Title**  
AI Video Creator / Generative AI Video Specialist

**Job Summary**  
We are looking for an **AI Video Creator** with hands-on experience using **AI-powered tools** to produce high-quality marketing videos, product demonstrations, social media reels, advertisements, and promotional content. The ideal candidate should be skilled in leveraging AI platforms to generate engaging visuals, animations, voiceovers, and video edits efficiently. **This role is designed for professionals who specialize in AI-driven video production and content creation, with a strong understanding of current AI tools and creative workflows to deliver compelling digital content.**

**Required Skills**

* ChatGPT
* Claude / Gemini
* Veo 3
* Runway ML
* Pika
* Kling AI
* HeyGen
* Synthesia
* Midjourney / Flux
* ElevenLabs
* CapCut AI
* Prompt Engineering
* AI video generation
* Basic video editing

**Responsibilities**

* Generate videos using AI tools.
* Create AI avatars, voiceovers, and cinematic scenes.
* Write prompts for text-to-video and image-to-video generation.
* Edit AI-generated content into social media videos.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan, shoot, and edit high-quality videos for social media, YouTube, ads, and branding campaigns Using AI tools.
* Create engaging reels, short-form videos, promotional videos, and corporate content.
* Develop creative concepts, storyboards, and visual narratives.
* Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to align video content with brand goals.
* Optimize videos for different platforms including Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and Linkedin
* Stay updated with the latest video trends, editing styles, and platform algorithms.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum 5+ years of professional experience in video creation
* Strong expertise in:
* Adobe Premiere Pro
* After Effects
* Final Cut Pro
* DaVinci Resolve (preferred)
* Photoshop/Illustrator basics
* Strong understanding of cinematography, lighting, framing, and audio
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Strong portfolio/showreel showcasing previous work is mandatory.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Creative Thinker with strong visual storytelling ability.
* Experience working with brands, agencies, or digital media companies.
* Understanding of viral content trends and audience engagement.
* Good communication and team collaboration skills.

Salary & Benefits

* Salary: Up to ₹80,000/month (Based on experience and skills)
* Opportunity to work on exciting creative projects
* Growth-oriented and collaborative environment

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
